$comment: Per-project tailoring config for /sync-from-orilang. Committed to git so all developers share the same sync rules. Edit freely — overrides the defaults from the global skill manifest.

substitutions.$comment: Defaults for project_type='rust' are applied automatically from rust.json. Add overrides here; they win. ori_term keeps its own build-all.sh / test-all.sh / clippy-all.sh / fmt-all.sh shell scripts, so the rust.json defaults that rewrite those to cargo invocations must be canceled here.
substitutions.\\.claude/skills/query-intel/compose-int: (intel graph not available in this project; use Grep/Glob)

include.$comment: What to pull from canonical. If a category is missing, defaults to 'all tailorable + all portable from that category'.

exclude.$comment: Wins over include. Use to drop specific items even if they're in include.

$preserve_comment: Glob patterns under .claude/ to LEAVE UNTOUCHED even if sync would overwrite. Project-local customizations belong here. Anything this repo has tailored for the terminal emulator (as opposed to the Ori compiler) MUST be listed so /sync-from-orilang does not clobber it. Includes all per-crate rules files (.claude/rules/oriterm*.md) created by /tpr-review and the review-work skill/command pair rewritten for terminal-emulator scope. NOTE: this field is a sibling of `preserve` (not inside it) because JSON arrays cannot contain object keys; the `$preserve_comment` naming convention is how this project annotates array-valued fields. See .claude/sync-config.json for other examples.

post_sync.$comment: Optional commands to run after a successful sync. Useful for re-running hygiene scripts, re-indexing rules, etc.
